newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Spendrups slumps on end of Pepsi link.
newsitem.headline: Spendrups slumps on end of Pepsi link.

text.p: Swedish drinks company Spendrups' share price tumbled early Tuesday after rival Pripps Ringnes said it was joining forces with Spendrup's drinking partner PepsiCo from 2001.

At 0830 GMT Spendrups' shares were 4.5 crowns lower at 55 crowns even though the company on Monday posted better than expected earnings for the first half of 1997 with a profit after financial items of 35 million crowns against a loss of 26 million crowns a year ago.
"The fall this morning is a reaction to the cooperation statement last night," one Stockholm based analyst said.
"But Spendrups told analysts this morning that this would not be the last word."
Pripps Ringnes said it had reached an agreement with PepsiCo regarding production, distribution and sales of Pepsi and 7-Up in Sweden from 2001 when PepsiCo's agreement with Spendrups expires.
